hey i would love for there to be improved integration of posthog into the product at different surfaces from funnels to the ai at different turns durations and posthogs various libraries. I want you to go all in, think of surveys you could add, think of all this stuff. here is some things post hog said could be improved as well: Here's the full picture from the first 36 hours of 3.0.0.

---

The quick summary

7 users started a session since launch. Remember: tracking may be undercounting, and some users block tracking entirely.

The funnel story

The biggest problem isn't the product — it's getting people into it. Of 16 visitors:

- 69% bounced without clicking "Start session" — this is your sharpest drop and the one worth fixing first
- 67% of people who started a session never sent a message — once users get in, something is blocking them from engaging

Everyone who sent a message got a response, so the core AI pipeline is healthy.

Feature adoption

Model switching is the standout feature — the majority of post-launch users changed models. Everything else (quiz, speech, session sharing, forking) has zero or near-zero usage. Those either need better discovery or more time.

Errors

Launch day had 4 error types: auth, invalid-request, model-unavailable, and unknown. The auth one is concerning — it could mean real users hit a wall when trying to authenticate.

---

Agent turn gaps to close (your specific ask)

Your agent_turn_completed event fires, but you're missing the full lifecycle:

Gap | Fix
No agent_turn_started | Add this — without it you can't measure latency or detect stuck turns
No model property | Add to agent_turn_completed and message_sent
No duration_ms | Measure from turn start to completion
No success/error flag | Can't distinguish clean turns from failed ones
No from_model/to_model on model_changed | Your most-used feature is completely opaque

The single highest-leverage fix: add agent_turn_started + duration_ms + model + success. That alone would make your most critical event actually useful for debugging and performance monitoring.

Also worth doing: add an app_version property to all events — without it you can't cleanly compare 3.0.0 vs future releases.

If you want to save this report as a permanent notebook, hit "Create notebook" in the UI above.
I’m tracing the actual web-agent execution path end to end, including retry/fork/cancel/tool branches, then I’ll return concrete telemetry insertion points and the tests that currently exercise them.

content.text:
Read-only lifecycle map delivered to the parent agent. No files were changed.

Key result: instrument the existing `agent.subscribe` in [useKeatingAgent.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:846). It sees normal prompts, retries, errors, aborts, tool loops, and final usage. `onBeforeSend` misses every `agent.continue()` retry.

Important gaps found:

- Current `agent_turn_completed` treats errors and cancellations as success.
- Its `turn_index` counts assistant messages, including tool-loop generations, unlike `message_sent`.
- `$ai_generation` should be emitted per assistant `message_end`, using final message model/provider/usage fields and never prompts, responses, tool arguments, or results.
- Auto-title, manual-title, DPO-alternative, topic categorization, and live voice bypass the Agent lifecycle and need separate instrumentation.
- Mid-stream model switching can unsubscribe the old Agent before its terminal event.
- The canonical conversation adapter also labels every `agent_end` as completed.
- Existing tests cover Agent timing, retry preparation, API retries, and branch helpers, but there are no PostHog lifecycle or chat send/cancel/retry tests.
